successors.name: Ayyubid Sultanate
successors.text: most of Bitlis and Van and parts of Muş provinces, drawn as whole provinces

ledger.x: 1100: 'The Beylik was founded by the Sökmen el-Kutbî who took over Ahlat (Khliat or Khilat) in 1100'; Encyclopaedia of Islam: 'the Turcoman rulers of Ahlat from 493/1100 to 604/1207'.
ledger.cp: holder of Ahlat (the Seljuks handed it to Sökmen; the page gives no year)

ledger.x: 1207: 'In 1207, the beylik was taken over by the Ayyubids, who had long coveted Ahlat.'

certainty.note: Ahlat and the Lake Van shore are certain; the extent is the page's 'most of Bitlis and Van, and parts of Muş' with no frontier.
